S_n_axis_action.stabilizer: S2 x S_{d-1} for one unordered pair

domain: integer d>=2 with n=d+1 relation-coordinate carriers and D={e_i-e_j:i!=j}

theorem.directed_states: d(d+1), exactly two orientations per unordered axis
theorem.fixed_recipient_specialization: With recipient fixed, inverse orientation is excluded; the d axes incident to that recipient correspond bijectively to d donors, recovering donor-memory cardinality d.
theorem.full_context_cardinality: d(d+1)/2 states are necessary and sufficient to remember the unrestricted straight axis.
theorem.primitive_dependence: Two directed transfer primitives are Z-linearly dependent iff they use the same unordered carrier pair, equivalently are equal or inverse.
theorem.rank_one: A nonempty history is rank-one iff all transfers use one unordered carrier pair.
